newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq slips further on tech weakness.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq slips further on tech weakness.

text.p: Nasdaq shares slipped another notch after Wednesday's sharp selloff, as Intel Corp led the technology sector lower.
The Nasdaq Composite Index shed 2.17 points or 0.16 percent to an unofficial close of 1346.27. The Dow industrials gained 26 points to 6773, an unofficial close.

"The tech stocks were active and volatile; Intel was under pressure most of the day. Techs were soft overall, but there were some small bright spots after yesterday's selloff," Jack Bayer managing director at Oppenheimer & Co said.
Intel lost 4-2/16 to 153-2/16, while Microsoft Corp lost 1-1/4 to 97-1/8. 3Com Corp fell 2-5/8 to 52-1/4. Apple Computer Inc gained 3/4 to 16.
Shares of USA Detergents Inc crumbled 13-7/8 to 20-3/8 after the household cleaning products company said it expects its fourth quarter revenues and profits will fall short of analysts' expectations.
But Applied Materials Inc showed strength, rising 3-1/2 to 47-5/8 after Morgan Stanley upgraded the stock to a strong buy and raised earnings estimates.
Losers beat gainers 2148 to 2126 on total volume of 634 million shares.
